entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Ne mboṅ, a loba lam na o weki mba o bia oa na o sesa oa. Na dube tatan bobo lam ngiṅango, tue lam mbwaṅ mongo. Loba dipepe di titi buka te oa mene mo mongwanedi o ndutu nu nye na momene.
